ize: A verb suffix signifying to make, to do, to practice; as apologize, baptize, theorize, tyrannize. Note: In the case of certain words the spelling with -ise (after analogy with F. -iser) is the usual form; as, catechise, criticise.
izedi: One of an Oriental religious sect which worships Satan or the Devil. The Izedis or Yezdis, the so-called Devil worshipers, still remain a numerous though oppressed people in Mesopotamia and adjacent countries. Tylor.
izard: A variety of the chamois found in the Pyrenees.
izzard: The letter z; -- formerly so called.
